text: 分层记忆把规则、事实和操作流程保存在项目与全局命名空间，并在 DSH 会话中提供检索、读写与管理工具。插件按条目保存来源证据和历史版本，可归档、恢复、迁移或推广条目；提示上下文中的 L1 索引受字符预算控制。Web 侧栏提供记忆管理页，输入区状态组件展示复核进度。适合希望跨会话保留项目知识并追溯依据的 DSH 用户；不需要额外 API 密钥，自动维护可使用 DSH 的模型与子 agent。

Layered Memory stores rules, facts, and procedures in project and global DSH spaces. Search and edit evidence-backed entries with history; archive, restore, migrate, or promote them. A bounded index enters the prompt. Web users get a memory page and review status. No API key is required.
让 DSH 在不同会话之间记住项目规则和事实。
我想给 agent 留下能持续使用的操作流程。
怎么搜索以前保存的项目笔记并查看来源？
需要把过时的记忆归档，还能找回来。
能不能把重要知识从项目空间共享到全局？
我想查看记忆修改历史并恢复旧版本。
Help me keep project knowledge available across DSH sessions.
I need searchable notes with evidence and revision history.
分层记忆的功能「检索记忆」：按关键词搜索当前项目和全局空间中的记忆条目，并返回可继续读取的条目引用。 通过记忆工具或 Web 管理界面触发。
分层记忆的功能「保存并更新」：创建 rule、fact 或 SOP 条目；更新时保留条目标识，并为已有版本保存历史快照。 通过记忆工具或 Web 管理界面触发。
分层记忆的功能「归档与历史恢复」：归档或恢复条目可见性，查看历史快照，并将指定快照恢复为当前内容。 通过记忆工具或 Web 管理界面触发。
分层记忆的功能「Web 记忆管理页」：通过 Web 侧栏打开独立管理页，浏览、搜索、编辑和归档记忆，并查看快照历史。 通过记忆工具或 Web 管理界面触发。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_read：按entry读取活跃或归档记忆。返回连续整行及revision；只有完整正文才complete=true。kind=index/rules/policy可读取完整索引、规则、L0。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_list：列出当前空间与全局空间的活跃条目，返回可直接读取的entry；include_archived显示归档。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_search：全文检索当前空间与default全局空间，默认只查活跃正文。需要历史内容时显式include_archived；每个结果entry均可memory_read。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_review：为尚未解决的规则或事实冲突登记复核。通常只需entry和reason：规则可引用当前回合原用户要求，事实绑定尚未保存的成功验证证据，返回sources精确引用。已有调用id时可显式选择。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_archive：归档或恢复可见性；归档正文仍可memory_read。replacement可指向已保存的替代entry。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_history：列出指定entry的精确历史快照。用返回的id作为memory_rollback的snapshot_id。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_rollback：恢复指定snapshot_id；省略时恢复最近快照。恢复前保存当前正文与元数据，可再从history撤销恢复。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_index：重建指定空间的完整L1磁盘索引；提示视图另外受字符预算限制。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_maintain：扫描记忆一致性和待办。review=true时主动认领并整理待办，等待模型维护结果；默认仅返回程序扫描。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_stats：查看所有空间的条目、历史、pending及最近维护状态。namespace可限定单个空间。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_pending：列出候选摘要和可读entry。使用memory_read读取候选，再接受整理后的内容或discard。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_accept：把候选整理成新的rule/fact/SOP。content填写精炼正文，evidence说明用户规则要求或事实验证依据；原候选留档。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_discard：关闭无需入库的候选并留可恢复的原文及处置原因。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_promote：把entry复制到目标空间（默认default全局），保留纯正文与原来源。目标同名已存在时报错；可归档源条目并链接新entry。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_namespace：列出命名空间与工作区映射，或迁移到新空间并保留原目录。目标必须为空。
@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory 提供工具 memory_expand：按精确sourceSeqs读取来源事件，支持普通工具与PTC子调用。用next继续读取完整证据，不序列化整份会话或模型内部元数据。

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Introduction：---
description: "Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness. Project and global indexes stay in context, entries carry structured identity and evidence, and earlier versions can be restored."
kind: "package-bundle"
---

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Summary：Layered memory carries rules, facts and operating procedures from one session into the next. Rules live in `rules.md`, facts under second-level headings in `facts.md`, and procedures in `sops/*.md`. All three use `{namespace, kind, key}` and the same memory tools, with sources and restorable history.

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add   github:DDDFXYqiming/dsh-layered-memory   "github:DDDFXYqiming/dsh-layered-memory#path:/lib/status"
```

Both specifiers are required because the bundle contributes two components: the memory plugin and the input-area status service. pnpm blocks exotic subdependencies, so the status package has to be declared as a direct dependency or a fresh install only gets the first component.

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Install：Desktop runs the same install through its bundled `dsh` command with the `desktop` profile. For local development, run `npm run build`, link the repository and `lib/status`, and point the profile at them.

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Use：The basic `memory_search/list/read/write/update` tools are available in each session. Load the `memory` skill or call `memory_activate({mode:"common"})` to add the status and conflict tools; management operations use `mode:"manage"`. User configuration controls access through `memoryAccess` and `subagentMemoryAccess`, with child agents read-only by default.

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Use：| Task | Tools |
| --- | --- |
| Find and read | memory_search, memory_list, memory_read |
| Create and update | memory_write, memory_update |
| Inspect evidence | memory_expand |
| Restore history | memory_history, memory_rollback |
| Archive and restore visibility | memory_archive |
| Share and migrate | memory_promote, memory_namespace |
| Process candidates | memory_pending, memory_accept, memory_discard |
| Inspect and maintain | memory_stats, memory_index, memory_maintain, memory_review |

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Use：Search covers active entries in the current and global spaces. Pass `include_archived:true` to reach archived content, then read the returned entry. A read reports its line range, total lines, revision, completeness and the next line offset. Use `rule` for an individual rule; `rules`, `index` and `policy` remain read-only views of the complete rule layer, index and management guidance. Existing index rules migrate on the first namespace initialization, and the index rule section is generated from active rule entries.

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Memory Management Page：The Web sidebar carries a “Memory” entry that opens a standalone page: the entry list on the left, the detail on the right. Search, filter by type, show archived entries, edit content and evidence in place, archive and restore, and review history snapshots with a rollback. Interface text follows the host language, and entry types show as Rule/Fact/Skill or 规则/事实/经验 depending on it. The data channel and the page rules live in the [memory page contract](docs/memory-browser-contract.md).

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Memory Management Page：The “Index used” line under the toolbar reports how much of the L1 index is taken and how many characters are used against the budget. Expanding it breaks the index into header, rules, facts and skills; hovering a section explains what it holds and how much it takes.

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Memory Management Page：The bundle also ships a separate Memory status component. Its line at the bottom of the Web composer shows the current session's review progress, the number of real changes or the reason the last run did not finish; clicking it opens run records and read-only history.

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: dsh-layered-memory
  config:
    defaultNamespace: ''
    autoNamespace: true

Automatic namespaces come from the workspace identity or the canonical root path; branches of one repository share the project memory and existing namespaces have to be migrated explicitly. `default` is the global space, included in project indexes and default searches. Character budgets cover index entries and manual rules together, and the full files stay readable through the tools.

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Configuration：The main agent reads and updates notes during its task while a background review checks the relevant notes for omissions, contradictions and duplication. End-of-turn review is on by default, batch maintenance runs under `reflectionMode: auto`, and index pressure work targets a watermark: the target character count is `l1MaxChars` × `indexTargetRatio`. Scheduling, budgets and checkpoints are covered in [automatic maintenance](docs/automatic-maintenance.zh.md).

@dsh-external/dsh-layered-memory README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- **Index folding hides detail**, when an index exceeds its character budget, entries are folded and descriptions are trimmed. The full body stays available through `memory_read`.
- **The index is a fixed per-session cost**, the project index is bounded by `l1MaxChars` and the global one by `globalL1MaxChars`, and over budget the hottest entries come first. The index sits in a stable prefix, so a write that changes it invalidates the cached tokens after it. See the [design notes](docs/design.md).
- **Maintenance spends model calls**, internal end-of-turn reviews and `reflectionMode: auto` runs invoke subagents. Budgets apply per maintenance run rather than per session.
- **Namespace identity is path based**, moving a project to another path creates a different namespace until it is migrated explicitly.
- **Tool access is per session**, basic memory tools come with the session and the memory skill or `memory_activate` adds the optional ones. Historical activation restores the tool mode only.
